## Episode Thesis

This is a Swedish party leaders' election debate hosted by Expressen and Dagens Industri, 27 days before the September 2026 election, not an investment podcast. The first hour covers household finances, inflation, temporary support such as the lower food VAT and fuel-tax cuts, raising the tax-free ISK limit, room for new reforms, and a proposed bank tax. The opposition says banks' excess profits are above 400bn SEK and wants to use state-owned SBAB to push down mortgage rates. The government side calls the bank tax an unfair 'mortgage tax' and describes Swedish business as very optimistic. No company-level investment views are given, but a change of government would raise the risk of a Swedish bank tax.
